name: Pricing - Monitor Competitors - Slack

assignments.name: reportText
assignments.value: ={{ const d = $json; const lines = ['*📊 Daily Competitor Pricing Report — ' + d.runDate + '*', '']; lines.push('*Summary:* ' + d.totalTracked + ' products tracked | ' + d.significantChanges + ' significant changes (>5%)'); lines.push('📈 Increased: ' + d.increased + '  |  📉 Decreased: ' + d.decreased); lines.push(''); lines.push('*Top Movers:*'); d.topChanges.forEach(p => { lines.push(p.direction + ' *' + p.name + '* (' + p.category + ')'); lines.push('   $' + p.previousPrice + ' → $' + p.currentPrice + '  (' + (p.changePct > 0 ? '+' : '') + p.changePct + '%)'); }); return lines.join('\n'); }}

assignments.name: reportText
assignments.value: ={{ "📊 Daily Competitor Pricing Report — " + $json.runDate + "\n✅ No significant price changes detected today (" + $json.totalTracked + " products monitored)." }}

description: Runs daily, fetches competitor pricing from a public API, analyzes changes, and posts a summary report to #pricing-alerts on Slack.
